recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No additional core FHIR source work is needed for FHIR-44864 unless a future work-group decision changes the allowed canonical target for Resource.$validate.profile.
issue_request: FHIR-44864 is an Applied/Persuasive FHIR-I change request for R6 asking that the Resource.$validate input parameter named profile be constrained to canonical(StructureDefinition), preventing unrelated canonical resources such as ActivityDefinition from being valid targets.
initial_application: Upstream commit 85f4e0aaf0 applied the request by adding targetProfile=http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/StructureDefinition to source/resource/operationdefinition-Resource-validate.xml. Later FHIR-50936 cleanup removed a duplicate profile parameter while preserving the constrained canonical on the remaining parameter.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists Resource as an active abstract infrastructure resource and source/resource/list-Resource-operations.xml references OperationDefinition/Resource-validate, so the checked OperationDefinition is build-scope source. FHIR-I 2024-03-04 minutes confirm the same decision. FHIR-44865 concerned the neighboring graph parameter and is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because both the worker source and the current combined branch already contain exactly one Resource.$validate.profile parameter with type canonical and targetProfile StructureDefinition.
